Locally hosted presentation dependencies for the read-only shared console.
Marked 12.0.2 and KaTeX 0.16.11 match the main console pins (MIT).
Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono variable fonts via Fontsource 5.2.6 (OFL).
Original package licenses are included. manifest.json records source archives
and hashes. Shared pages make no third-party requests for these assets.
